facts.text: The emotion analysis suggests both ISIS and Catholic materials used words that aim to inspire readers while avoiding fear.
facts.source_quote: The result of our emotion analysis suggests that both corpuses used words that aim to inspire readers while avoiding fear.

facts.text: Although the two corpora produce a similar emotional effect, the actual words that lead to that effect differ substantially between the two contexts.
facts.source_quote: However, the actual words that lead to these effects are very different in the two contexts.

facts.text: The authors conclude that, using proper methods, automated analysis of large bodies of textual data can provide novel insight into extremist propaganda that can assist the counterterrorism community.

relations.text: The similar inspire/avoid-fear emotional effect found in both corpora is produced by very different underlying word choices in each context.
